description: Default permissions for Skrivro. IMPORTANT: the core:window:allow-close, allow-destroy, allow-minimize, allow-set-title, allow-start-dragging, allow-is-fullscreen, allow-set-fullscreen, and allow-toggle-maximize entries below are NOT redundant with core:default — they are not included in core:window:default and must be granted explicitly. Removing allow-close/allow-destroy will silently break window closes (including the dirty-confirm close handler, because Tauri's onCloseRequested library internally calls destroy() after the handler). Removing allow-minimize will break the macOS Window > Minimize menu item. Removing allow-set-title will break window title updates (because Tauri does not auto-sync document.title to the native window title — setTitle() is explicit). Removing allow-start-dragging will silently break the data-tauri-drag-region attribute — mouse drag on the titlebar does nothing at all. Removing allow-is-fullscreen / allow-set-fullscreen will break the macOS Window > Enter/Exit Full Screen menu item (allow-is-fullscreen is also used by the post-install onResized listener that syncs the item's text). Removing allow-toggle-maximize will break the macOS Window > Zoom menu item.
